info.title: Longshot RFQ API
info.description:
RFQ trading API for binary options on crypto assets.

## Authentication

All RFQ endpoints require a session token obtained via `/v1/auth/wallet` or `/v1/auth/session`.
Pass the token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

## Signing Orders

Orders must be signed with secp256k1 (EVM) using a specific binary format.
See `fixtures/api/SIGNING.md` for the exact signing format.

**Key points:**
- Auth messages use milliseconds, not seconds
- Orders are signed as BINARY, not JSON
- Unit conversions: `wager_micros * 10000 = wager_micros`, `min_odds * 10000 = min_odds_bps`

post.summary: Authenticate with a direct wallet signature.
post.description:
The server reconstructs the message in this format:
```text
Longshot Wallet Authentication

Version: 1
Domain: <configured_domain>
Auth Address: <checksum_address>
Timestamp: <signed_at_ms>
```
Clients submit the address, timestamp, and signature, not message text.
Wallet authorization defaults to a 60-second freshness window and tolerates
timestamps up to 30 seconds ahead for clock skew. A successful public wallet
session lasts 24 hours; the signing window does not shorten the bearer lifetime.

get.summary: Get the stored current-slot open for the requested market window.
get.description:
The request path resolves the current slot locally and reads the current-slot
market plus its stored `open_strike_micros`; it does not fetch RTDS,
Binance, or Polymarket data per request.

The endpoint reports the stored value only; it does not infer or expose
whether that value came from automated lifecycle opening, admin market
creation, or admin market opening.

- `ok`: a current-slot market exists and its stored open strike is available
- `pending`: a current-slot market exists, but the current-slot open strike has not been persisted yet
- `unavailable`: no current-slot market exists for the requested asset/window, or the slot cannot be resolved locally

get.summary: Stream live market ticks over browser-friendly SSE.
get.description:
`timeframe_secs` selects the same live price source contract as candles:
- `300` / `900` -> Polymarket
- `3600` -> Binance

Recent replay is retained in a bounded in-memory ring buffer for each
`(asset, price_source)` pair, so short reconnect gaps can often resume from
`since_seq` even after a brief idle period. If replay does not fully cover
a requested pair from the requested resume point, the handler performs a
latest-window storage-backed catch-up for the missing prefix before
continuing with live events. That request-path catch-up is row-capped per
subscription so reconnect recovery stays bounded.
For `300`/`900`, that persisted Polymarket path may include Binance-derived
continuity repair rows.
Storage catch-up rows are flagged `is_synthetic=true` and preserve cursor
ordering without minting new broadcaster sequence cursors.
Older gaps are not repaired on the request path, so callers should continue sending
`since_ms` alongside `since_seq` when reconnecting.

The stream emits `tick` events with `MarketTickStreamEvent` JSON payloads.
Tick events include `price_source` metadata so direct chart consumers can
verify source alignment across reconnects.

If post-subscription publisher storage access fails, the stream emits a
`stream_error` event with a `MarketTickStreamErrorEvent` JSON payload for
affected subscribers, then closes so clients can reconnect with the
advertised `retry_after_ms` delay.

provide an explicit external destination.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied idempotency key for replay-safe submission.

UserWithdrawRequest.description: Request to move funds from the app balance back into onchain settlement balance.

UserWithdrawResponse.description: Response after successfully debiting app balance and withdrawing to settlement.

amount_micros.description: Amount withdrawn back into the user's settlement balance, in USDC micros.

destination_address.description: EVM address that received the withdrawn USDC.

operation_id.description: Operation ID used for idempotency/recovery correlation.

tx_hash.description:
Transaction hash for the successful `LongshotSettlement.withdraw()` or
`LongshotSettlement.protocolWithdraw()` call.

VaultAmountResponse.description:
Aggregate vault liquidity bucket.

Public vault overview responses expose vault-wide totals only. Caller-level
allocation details are available from authenticated user vault endpoints.

VaultClaimFeesResponse.description: Response after successfully claiming vault manager fees.

VaultLiquidityProviderResponse.description: Liquidity-provider share exposed by vault APIs.

VaultPnlHistoryPoint.description: Single point on the vault's PnL / account-value time series.

value_micros.description: Cumulative metric value in micros as of `t_ms`.

VaultPositionResponse.description: Row in the paginated vault positions listing.

VaultPositionVaultResponse.description: Wrapped response for a vault position-vault read.

VaultResponse.description:
Public vault overview.

This response contains aggregate vault state. Caller-specific fields such as
`latest_deposit_time_ms` and `pending_withdrawal` are returned by the
authenticated `GET /v1/user/vault/performance` endpoint.

VaultStatsResponse.description: Aggregate stats for a vault, backing the vault screen header.

VaultUserPerformanceResponse.description:
Authenticated per-user performance card response.

Carries the caller's own vault balances, performance, latest deposit time,
and pending withdrawal state. Public vault overview endpoints expose only
aggregate vault totals.

latest_deposit_time_ms.description:
Millisecond timestamp of the caller's most recent deposit, or `None` if
they have never deposited.

VaultWithdrawalAmountRequest.description: Tagged wire format for vault withdrawal requests.

VaultWithdrawalAmountResponse.description: Tagged wire format for vault withdrawal amounts exposed over the API.

VaultWithdrawalQueueResponse.description: Response containing the persisted vault withdrawal queue.

VerifyInviteCodeRequest.description: Request to verify an invite code before starting auth. Non-consuming.

void_requested_at_ms.description: When the void was requested; refunds land on the next resolution sweep.

VoidSurvivorRoundRequest.description:
Admin request to void one Survivor round (the contest id is in the path).
Only the current round or the last scheduled round (highest `game_index`)
may be voided. A current round advances or settles existing survivors; an
empty opening is removed so round zero can be replaced. A last scheduled
future round is unscheduled.

current_game_index.description:
The contest's current pointer after the void. It advances for a current
non-final round with entries; an empty opening, final round, or future
round leaves it unchanged.

was_current_round.description:
`true` when the voided round was current. Entrants advance or settle as
final co-winners; an empty opening instead awaits a replacement round.
`false` means the last scheduled future round was unscheduled (its row
is deleted).

VoidedFantasyMarketRecoveryRequest.description:
Explicit, stale-safe authorization to replace selected unused voided
markets from a prior Lineups contest. Every expected source must also be in
this create request.

WalletAuthRequest.description: Request to authenticate with direct wallet signature.

address.description: User's wallet address (hex, with or without 0x prefix).

invite_code.description:
One-time invite code; required for brand-new accounts while the
invite phase is active. Case-insensitive. Ignored for existing users.

referral_code.description: Referral slug used as an alternative signup gate for brand-new accounts.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the server-reconstructed authentication message.

signed_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds bound into the signed message.

WithdrawOperationResponse.description:
Response for withdrawal endpoints.

Freshly completed operations return a `UserWithdrawResponse` with a tx hash.
Idempotency replays and asynchronous recovery paths return a durable
operation status response.

oneOf.description: Fresh Privy identity proof for a withdrawal.

token.description: Fresh Privy identity token for the authenticated user.

oneOf.description: Fresh EIP-191 proof for a wallet-authenticated withdrawal.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the canonical withdrawal authorization message.

signed_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds bound into the signed message.

WithdrawalAuthorization.description: Fresh authorization supplied with a withdrawal request.

WithdrawalDeliveryStatus.description: Delivery status returned when a newly submitted withdrawal is queued onchain.

WithdrawalPolicyResponse.description: Admin response for reading or updating global withdrawal policy.
